title: Corona Weekend Planner: Halloween Fun at Dos Lagos and Family Time Around Town

coverage_window.timezone_note: Friday and Saturday times are PDT. Pacific Standard Time resumes Sunday, November 1.

seo_summary: Plan a positive Corona weekend with library coding, Dos Lagos Halloween fun and a Sunday visit to Santana Park.
